subject: Health Insurance Options
body:
Hallo,

my name is Thomas Weber, born on 22 July 1978. I'm looking into private health insurance options as my current public insurance doesn't cover everything I need.

I live at Friedrichstraße 42, 10117 Berlin and work as an accountant. I've been dealing with some back issues lately and want to make sure I have proper coverage for physiotherapy and specialist visits.

My phone number is +49 30 9876543, but I prefer to communicate by email if possible. Actually, no — I find it easier to discuss things over the phone, so please call me during business hours.

I'd appreciate if you could send me a comparison of your health insurance plans.

Best regards,
Thomas Weber
